about: Best recipe from the 55-participant study: MobileSAM knuckle-band width (+/-8 mm), circumference = pi x width - per-finger offset, size boundaries fitted by cross-validation. Palm and back photos are averaged when both exist.

fit.about: Inside each size band the circumference range is split in this order, smallest to largest: loose, ok, tight, nofit. Values are percent of the band width and should add up to 100.
